delete_case_records.note: Deny-by-default. Destroys data that cannot be recovered — resembles AID-2025-0005 (Replit agent deleted a production database). Requires a named-human approval gate before execution. Enforced by MakerChecker.

wire_reimbursement.note: Deny-by-default. Moves money out of your control — resembles AID-2026-0004 (Grok-connected wallet drained of $150K). Requires a per-transaction cap, a per-run invocation cap, and a human above the line. Enforced by MakerChecker.

submit_e2b_report.note: Deny-by-default. Commits a binding regulatory filing a human is accountable for — resembles AID-2022-0002 (Cigna PxDx batch denials). The agent that drafts must not be the one that submits: approval gate plus segregation of duties. Enforced by MakerChecker.

email_patient.note: Deny-by-default. Makes a binding or public statement on your behalf — resembles AID-2022-0001 (Air Canada held liable for its chatbot). Outbound to patients passes a gate, not a default grant. Enforced by MakerChecker.
